title: tephrosia aurantiaca subsp. rufopilosa
intro: Tephrosia aurantiaca subsp. rufopilosa, commonly known as the yellow milk pea, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family, known for its bright yellow flowers and medicinal properties. The plant is used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal problems, due to its reported health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include relieving pain, reducing fever, and soothing digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Tephrosia aurantiaca subsp. rufopilosa include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
